Let's Build a Chess Ontology (Part 2)

Released Sep 9, 2025, 42 min

Play Let's Build a Chess Ontology (Part 2) on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

This is the second of a series where we'll build an ontology about chess together. We review the prefixes at the top of the page, look into using Protege as a compiler, and start representing classes of chess pieces. And somehow it took more than a half hour--time flies when you're ontologizing!
